record.reason: Pollux is explicitly a deep-learning cluster scheduler that jointly tunes resources, batch sizes and learning rates for distributed DL training jobs. Its goodput metric combines training system throughput and statistical efficiency; the experiments and conclusion address training-job scheduling, not LLM inference or serving. Excluded under the training-only scope rule.
record.title: Pollux: Co-adaptive Cluster Scheduling for Goodput-Optimized Deep Learning
